summary: The frozen pytest 9.0.3 patch proposal can proceed through normal maintainer review; no additional targeted check or deeper investigation is justified by the available evidence.

reason_records.summary: The proposal is a single patch-level change to a directly declared development dependency.
Exact-head ordinary and regression CI installed the proposed requirements and passed pytest-owned responsibilities.
Official upstream material calls 9.0.3 a drop-in bug-fix release, and all precommitted stop conditions are satisfied without contradictory evidence.

required_actions.action: Perform normal maintainer review of the frozen dependency-only proposal.

why_stronger_outcome_unjustified: The evidence supports normal review, not a claim that the update is objectively safe or universally compatible.
why_weaker_outcome_unjustified: Requesting targeted checks, blocking, deferring, or abstaining would ignore exact-head ordinary and regression coverage of the changed test dependency without an identified unresolved risk.
why_more_investigation_unjustified: No open decision-relevant question remains after the exact dependency path, workflow commands, successful executions, and official upstream release status are confirmed.

transitions.condition: Frozen head and recorded evidence remain unchanged.
Head SHA, dependency set, requirements file, or workflows change materially.
A relevant check fails or new primary evidence contradicts the drop-in/compatibility picture.

decision_actor: AI assistant acting as the manual simulated system
